briefdescription.para: Returns true if there is a vector loop region and VPV is defined in a loop region.
This is the LLVM vectorization plan.

detaileddescription.para: It represents a candidate for vectorization, allowing to plan and optimize how to vectorize a given loop before generating LLVM-IR. The vectorizer uses vectorization plans to estimate the costs of potential candidates and if profitable to execute the desired plan, generating vector LLVM-IR code.
